194:t_3:52.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$ is an android, but her memories of the past are hazy.」

194:t_3:53.en:
$$ラルク$$
「And this $$ノノリリ$$ is supposedly the space pilot she looks up to.」

194:t_3:54.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right! $$ノノリリ$$ is a pure, righteous, beautiful girl who fought carrying the future of humanity on her shoulders!」

194:t_3:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Long, beautiful hair, a knockout body, the smile of a holy mother... She is truly the symbol of humanity's hope!」

194:t_3:56.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I-I'm nothing like her at all... It's sad, but true...」

194:t_3:57.en:
$$ノノ$$
「See? Now you know your place!」

194:t_3:58.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Geez, you... You're out of line, and you're ignoring your own clumsiness.」

194:t_3:60.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The $$姫$$ is right. Just because your names are similar, $$ノノ$$, you're overreacting way too much to $$ノリコ$$.」

194:t_3:61.en:
$$チコ$$
「According to $$カシオ$$, that $$ガンバスター$$ thing and our $$バスターマシン$$s really do use different lines of technology.」

194:t_3:62.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well... it isn't using $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$, so that's only natural, if you think about it.」

194:t_3:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then why do they have the same name, $$バスターマシン$$?」

194:t_3:64.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I think it's the same as how $$ガンダム$$s exist in all sorts of parallel worlds.」

194:t_3:65.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So that $$ガンバスター$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$ from a parallel world...」

194:t_3:66.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Given those $$宇宙怪獣$$ we've never seen before, that's the reasonable way to look at it.」

194:t_3:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「When you put it that way, it makes sense...!」

194:t_3:68.en:
$$チコ$$
「Maybe that girl $$ノリコ$$ is even the same person as your idol $$ノノリリ$$, just from a parallel world...!」

194:t_3:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Impossible! Parallel world or not, she's a completely different person from $$ノノ$$'s $$ノノリリ$$!」

194:t_3:70.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If that kind of thing flies, then a parallel-world $$竜馬$$ being a clean-cut student could happen too!」

194:t_3:71.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...So are you convinced for now, $$ノノ$$?」

194:t_3:73.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm sorry. That my $$ガンバスター$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$, just like your idol's.」

194:t_3:74.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But $$ガンバスター$$ is very precious to me. So please don't speak too badly of it.」

194:t_3:75.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-I'm sorry, $$ノリコ$$... $$ノノ$$'s heart was tainted...」

194:t_3:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Over the $$バスターマシン$$s and $$ノノリリ$$, $$ノノ$$... $$ノノ$$...」

194:t_3:77.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's all right. ...From now on, we're comrades fighting together in the same $c.」

194:t_3:78.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you, $$ノリコ$$! $$ノノ$$ will do her best with hard work and guts too!」

194:t_3:79.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That again, huh... Lean on stuff like that and you'll be an apprentice forever.」

194:t_3:80.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Wait a second, $$ラルク$$. What you just said... I can't let that slide.」

194:t_3:82.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「There's no victory without hard work and guts...! Anyone who mocks hard work and guts is always defeated by their own weakness in the end!」

194:t_3:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$ is right, Big Sis...! Hard work and guts are the very power that creates hope!」

194:t_3:87.en:
$$チコ$$
「So in the end, they seem to have hit it off...」

194:t_3:88.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Oh, it's fine. They're fellow $$バスターマシン$$ pilots from parallel worlds. Let's all get along.」

194:t_3:89.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Right... for the sake of what's ahead, too...)

194:t_3:90.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Looks like things have settled down for now.」

194:t_3:91.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! From today, $$ノノ$$ and $$ノリコ$$ are BFFs!」

194:t_3:92.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So, that's how it is. I look forward to working with you all again, everyone.」

194:t_3:94.en:
$$チコ$$
「What...? Jealous that your little sister got taken?」

194:t_3:96.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't worry, Big Sis! Big Sis is the one and only Big Sis for $$ノノ$$!」

194:t_3:98.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$ノリコ$$, were you captured at that base too?」

194:t_3:99.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes... I was fighting alongside the $$連邦軍$$ in the East Pacific, but I was caught in the enemy's cowardly trap.」

194:t_3:101.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...They made the people they'd captured stand on the battlefield unprotected, and used them as a human shield.」

194:t_3:103.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「With $$ガンバスター$$'s power, I couldn't attack without hurting those people, and...」

194:t_3:104.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you had no choice but to surrender.」

194:t_3:105.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「After that, I was brought to this base, but it seems the $$サイデリアル$$ were interested in $$ガンバスター$$, and kept investigating it.」

194:t_3:106.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I think the reason they kept me alive, as the pilot, was also because of $$ガンバスター$$.」

194:t_3:107.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「By the way, is that provocative costume to the taste of the $$サイデリアル$$?」

194:t_3:108.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This is a combat suit of the $$トップ部隊$$.」

194:t_3:109.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can keep a spare in the cockpit of the $$バスターマシン$$, and I'm glad it wasn't confiscated.」

194:t_3:110.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ノリコ$$... What's the name of the one who used that cowardly trick...」

194:t_3:111.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The name is... $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$.」

194:t_3:113.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It seems most of the members of $c have a score to settle with that man.」

194:t_3:114.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then let's all pay him back together.」

194:t_3:115.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And double it, with plenty of interest on top.」

194:t_3:117.en:
$$カレン$$
「The imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$... Maybe that guy and that $$尸空#pilot$$ are there too.」

194:t_3:118.en:
$$甲児$$
「Bring it on...! I'll settle the war with the Empire in one go!」

194:t_3:121.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I've received a report on the situation in the capital from Major $$カリーニン$$. Naturally, the forces prepared there far outnumber this $$ターミナル・ベース$$...」

194:t_3:122.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But with our concentration of forces, a breakthrough at a single point should be quite possible.」

194:t_3:123.en:
$$甲児$$
「Having come this far, it's not a question of odds. To end this war, we have no choice but to crush the head, ready to die for it.」

194:t_3:124.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's the iron rule of a brawl.」

194:t_3:125.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do it. To bring peace back to Earth once more.」

194:t_3:126.en:
$$シモン$$
「...By the way, what about $$ランカ$$? I heard she was rescued together with $$シェリル$$...」

194:t_3:127.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$アルト$$ is with her now. Being held captive seems to have been really hard on her.」

194:t_3:128.en:
$$シモン$$
「I see... I'll go visit her once she's calmed down.」

194:t_3:129.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(In the end, we never figured out why the Empire abducts citizens...)

194:t_3:130.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(What was the reason for abducting $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$? Is it part of some cultural control...)

194:t_3:131.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(And the investigation of $$ガンバスター$$... Maybe the Empire is hiding something we still don't know about...)

トップ部隊.evidence: Official English term for the Gunbuster pilot squad (Aim for the Top! Gunbuster; Top Squad).

kept_omissions: 194:t_3:79: Lal'C's muttered 'you'll stay an apprentice' has no explicit addressee; scene (Nono's hard-work-and-guts catchphrase) settles Nono, so 'you' is used.
194:t_3:114: 'そいつを返してやろう' - object is the debt (借り) owed to Barbiel; rendered 'pay him back' (subject/object restored).
uncertain: 194:t_3:73: 'あなたの憧れの存在のバスターマシン' rendered 'a Buster Machine, just like your idol's'; could also mean the Buster Machine of Nono's idol herself.
194:t_3:92: line is written in です-style (Nono-like) but the brief speaker is Noriko; translated as Noriko's greeting to everyone ('again' = her re-introduction).
194:t_3:97: Noriko's お姉さま rendered 'Big Sis' to match Nono's settled rendering; Noriko may be thinking of her own senior Onee-sama.
194:t_3:108: トップ部隊 = 'Top Squad' (new token, official Gunbuster term; not in glossary).
194:t_3:64: ガンダム used as $$ガンダム$$s token (plural outside); earlier slices used plain 'Gundam'.
194:t_3:112/117: あいつ = Barbiel (male per glossary) rendered 'that guy'.
194:t_3:107: Nicola's 趣味 rendered 'taste'; $$サイデリアル$$ used as plural group ('the $$サイデリアル$$').
